description: Canonical aggregate benchmark files in results/ and lineage of superseded local runs. Full per-query JSON traces stay local under reports/ (gitignored).

canonical_offline_retrieval.scope: 5 retrieval configurations on n=61 answerable (span-overlap >= 50%, B=2,000 bootstrap CIs) + n=19 negatives

canonical_dspy_holdout.scope: Quarantined 32-item test split (train/dev excluded from compile); retrieved hybrid top-4 vs oracle-context arms

superseded_runs.reason: Used max_tokens=500 on reasoning models (truncating 11/80 DeepSeek static, 51/80 Qwen static, and 7/80 agentic outputs to empty strings), an un-rejudged lexical fallback report in the earlier paradigm table, and a Hop-2 grader slice bug (chunks[:4]). Superseded by the 2026-11-20 max_tokens=4000 runs.

probe_labels_scope.purpose: In-sample regression guard for offline lexical judge—not independent multi-annotator consensus on live model outputs.
